utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably join, but I need the exact pickup time and full route first. If that fits my schedule, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’ll get the exact pickup time and route and send them over. Gus can help too, and I’m already in Cleo’s carpool as an extra rider.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — please send the exact pickup time and full route when you have them, and I’ll check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted if the carpool time changes, and I’ll listen for the exact school pickup time too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll ask around today and pass the details along to Pia too. And I’ll keep Nell in the loop since she’s still catching up on everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — appreciate it. Just send me the exact pickup time when you hear back, and I’ll keep Kira posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — thanks. I’ll keep an ear out, and it sounds like Rosa will send the final schedule once the seats are set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — I’ll coordinate the carpool for Sam and Lina at 7:30, and I’ll make sure the final schedule gets shared once the seats are set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll wait for Rosa’s final schedule and keep asking around in case anyone else needs a seat.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — I’ll keep repeating the carpool plan to everyone so it stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’m planning to be on time. I’ll send the time and pick-up spot so Uli can cover if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — send me the time and pick-up spot, and I’ll make sure everyone hears the plan clearly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Mina will be ready and waiting for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. I’ll be the first stop at 7:45, and Opal’s got the route and pickup spots covered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect — first stop at 7:45 works for me. Thanks for confirming the route and pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ve got a couple of seats confirmed, and Bo can handle the 7:45 pickup. I’ll send the final schedule once it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, but can you confirm the full route too? And please let me know right away if the time changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the full route and keep you posted right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—Oren can send me the pickup time and route, and I’ll text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll keep Leo posted on the pickup spot and we’re set for the weekday 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. carpool. Text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — I’m coordinating the carpool this week, and Jules can send me the school times and pickup details. Tess, if you hear the exact pickup time, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana said the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, and I’m ready at 7:30 AM. Do you want Gus to help out too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mina — 7:30 AM works, and yes, please ask Gus if he can help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll send Eli the pickup time and route, and I’m hoping Ira can check their schedule too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — Bo’s first stop is Bo’s place, and I’ll keep noting the rest of the route as we go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that works — I’ll keep Eli posted on the pickup time and route. And if Ira can swing it, even better for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check whether I can help with the carpool this week. Also, Leo should be ready at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Vik said he’d repeat the carpool plan to everyone and keep it clear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — that should help keep everyone on the same page. I’ll see whether I can pitch in this week.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the carpool supplies ready, and Rey is confirmed. Let’s just make sure Dane tries to be on time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — and we still need rides for Sam and Lina at 7:30. Jules is lining that up, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, then we’re all set on my end. I’ll keep the supplies ready and just hope Dane is on time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. If Rey needs a ride, just let me know and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — weekdays at 8:00 a.m. or 5:30 p.m. work best for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — I can work with those times. If Rey needs a seat, I’ll make room.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’ll do the carpool at 8, and I’ll keep everyone posted so it stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I’ve got a couple of seats confirmed, and Bo can do the 7:45 pickup. I’ll send the final schedule once it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll repeat the final schedule to everyone once you send it, and I’ll keep the carpool details clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll text if the carpool plans change.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I still need the exact pickup time and full route before I can confirm. Please keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oren will send me the pickup time and route, and Opal is keeping track of the pickup spot and time. I’ll let you know as soon as I have everything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can do the carpool. I’ll keep an eye out for Dane’s text about the time and pick-up spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli — Rosa’s still locking in a couple seats and will send the final schedule once it’s set. Quinn’s asking around today, so I’ll share who’s interested when I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, thanks — I’ll watch for Dane’s text and stay ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll send Eli the pickup time and route, and I’m hoping Ira can check whether their schedule works as an extra driver.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact pickup time and full route before anything’s set? And please let me know right away if the time changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes — I’ll confirm the exact pickup time and full route first, and I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. work best for me on weekdays.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works for me too. I’m already in Cleo’s carpool as an extra rider, and Gus can help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, then let’s keep the weekday pickups at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll coordinate the carpool for Sam and Lina at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check if I can help with the carpool this week. And Leo should be ready at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks—I’ll stick with Sam and Lina for 7:30, and Leo being ready at 7:15 helps too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with the carpool. If Rey needs a ride too, just let me know and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — Sam and Lina still need rides at 7:30, and Jules is lining that up. I’ll let you know if Rey needs anything too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just keep me posted, and I’ll be ready if they still need an extra car.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the carpool supplies ready, and Rey is all set to ride. Just hoping Dane can try to be on time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, and Hana said it’s still on for tomorrow, so we’re good. I’ll be ready at 7:30 AM.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep everything ready, and hopefully Dane makes it on time. See you at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo’s first stop is Bo’s place, and I’ll keep track of the rest of the route as we go.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll keep you posted if the carpool time shifts, and I’ll listen for the exact pickup time too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep track of the pickup spot and time, and note any route changes as they come up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Vik said he’d repeat the carpool plan to everyone and keep it clear. That should help me not miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around today and pass the carpool details along, including to Pia.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out for Vik’s update so I don’t miss the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can handle the weekday carpool at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. Leo and I just need to lock in the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — I’m coordinating this week, so I’ll get the pickup spot sorted and confirm the exact times once Jules sends the school details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Faye — thanks for sorting the pickup spot. Just send me the confirmed times and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll be there on time. I just need to send the time and pick-up spot to Uli, and then we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — and just to confirm, Mina will be ready and waiting for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, then I’ll send Uli the time and pick-up spot right now so we’re all set.

injected.text: Update: the morning carpool now leaves at 8am from the church parking lot, not 7am from the school lot.
